brief.name: Connector inspection lens
brief.purpose: Lens above capped connector with separate clean, dirty and damaged inspection panels
brief.learningIntent: O05; inspect before changing; never direct eyes into a live optical port
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: A mounted inspection lens sits over a disconnected connector. Three discs show a smooth end face, specks and a deep scratch.
binding.caption: At the inspection dock, compare the clean, contaminated and damaged example end faces before changing the connection. Use the inspection equipment with the source safely isolated. Never look into a live optical port.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
